# svg-slides set: Gradient Mesh (`mesh`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Gradient-mesh style: a painterly field of overlapping glowing blobs (hot pink, violet, cyan, warm orange) made of stacked translucent circles (gradient defs are not allowed in designs, so the soft edges are banded), white Arial Black display type with a knockout halo in the surface colour, an Arial body. The light theme is a pale pastel field with the same blobs and dark text. Not any template's brand.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set mesh --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- Mesh-gradient backgrounds in contemporary brand and app design: four to six colour nodes (pink, violet, cyan, orange) blended into a soft painterly field.
- Knockout / halo text treatments used to keep type legible over busy colour.

slots, not literal hues: `--teal` is this set's primary. `--block` / `--on-block` are the
colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: overlapping stacked-circle blobs (pink, violet, orange, cyan) across the field; every text slot carries a knockout halo in the surface colour. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: the chapter number sits on the violet node at the left; eyebrow, two-line heavy title and orientation line to the right, all with halos. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide: cyan node top left, pink bottom right, violet below; three flush-left heavy statement lines with the halo outline. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Content slide: pink and violet nodes at the corners; text with halos on the left; the graphic on a translucent card-colour panel on the right. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: violet and pink nodes at the corners, a large translucent panel for the graphic and the takeaway in halo text on the right. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: four mesh blobs; a large heavy title with the contact lines and meta line, all halo-outlined. |
